label.zh: 阶段二事件：增压路线 / 过量供给路线
label.en: Stage-2 event: supercharge route / overfeed route

note.zh: 由 cstorms.2000 的选择设置标志 approach_supercharge_selected 或 approach_overfeed_selected。
note.en: Set by the choice in cstorms.2000 (flags approach_supercharge_selected or approach_overfeed_selected).

label.zh: 增压路线的终结：辐射 / 切断 / 磁化
label.en: Finishers of the supercharge route: irradiate / sever / magnetize

note.zh: 由 cstorms.2010 选择的取向决定。
note.en: Decided by the approach chosen in cstorms.2010.

label.zh: 过量供给路线的终结：搅动 / 失稳 / 扰乱
label.en: Finishers of the overfeed route: agitate / destabilize / scramble

note.zh: 由 cstorms.2015 选择的取向决定。
note.en: Decided by the approach chosen in cstorms.2015.

scope.zh: “聚集风暴”：研究船在宇宙风暴中启动局势，两条路线、六种终结。
scope.en: "Gather the Storm": a research ship starts the situation at a cosmic storm; two routes and six finishers.

uncertain: The fleet order initiate_cosmic_storm_order appears in the script files only inside the situation definition (the order itself is engine-side), so the exact start cannot be verified in the files.
